title: Energy Engine Zone Air Modules
description: Create Rust source files for energy_engine: zone_air.rs, room_air.rs, gains.rs, air_exchange.rs, airflow_network.rs, iaq.rs, comfort.rs, controls.rs with real physics, tests, regions, crate:: imports.
summary: Added eight energy_engine physics modules (zone air balance with BDF3/analytical humidity, room air distribution models, internal gains decomposition, infiltration/ventilation/interzone/hybrid air exchange, pressure-driven multizone airflow network, CO2/contaminant IAQ with DCV, ISO 7730 comfort, and zone controls). Wired modules in lib.rs; all 33 new unit tests pass.
